SDK: .NET SDK 9.0.316
Compiler: Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler 9.0.18, runtime.win-x64.microsoft.dotnet.ilcompiler 9.0.18
Linker: MSVC 14.44.35207 Hostx64\x64\link.exe
Runtime source tag: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/tree/v9.0.18
Managed calling convention: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/runtime/v9.0.18/docs/design/coreclr/botr/clr-abi.md
ECMA-335 calling-convention byte: ECMA-335 6th edition, II.23.2.1 MethodDefSig, HASTHIS 0x20
ECMA-335 void return: ECMA-335 6th edition, II.23.2.11 RetType, VOID is the element type System.Void
Microsoft x64 argument registers: RCX, RDX, R8, R9 for integer and pointer arguments
Microsoft x64 floating-point argument registers: XMM0, XMM1, XMM2, XMM3 for Single and Double arguments
Microsoft x64 shared argument positions: position N is either the integer register or the vector register, never both, so an integer argument still consumes the vector register of its position and a floating-point argument still consumes the integer register of its position
Microsoft x64 hidden struct return: a return value larger than eight bytes is written through a caller-supplied pointer passed in RCX, which shifts every declared argument to the next position
Convention low nibble on this image: 0x0 for static methods and 0x0 plus HASTHIS for instance methods and constructors
Command: dotnet publish managed_abi_fp_net9_x86_64.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o publish
Build directory: the project, Program.cs and publish output live outside the repository; PathMap rewrites the project directory to C:\src\feat017 so no build path is embedded
